cis_text.title: Securely Dispose of Data

evidence.rationale: Secure disposal reduces residual sensitive files on endpoints and servers that an adversary could later collect from local storage.
Secure disposal reduces obsolete or unnecessary sensitive data left on shared drives, limiting what an adversary can collect from network shares.
The safeguard specifically concerns secure deletion and sanitization of residual data artifacts.
Secure disposal reduces stale sensitive records in repositories such as document stores, collaboration platforms, or knowledge bases.
Secure disposal directly addresses preventing unauthorized recovery or persistence of sensitive data remnants.
Secure disposal reduces sensitive data retained in cloud object storage, lowering the value of compromised storage access
This applies when secure disposal explicitly removes old credential files, keys, exports, secrets, or configuration files that could expose credentials.
This control protects against attacker behaviors that destroy or overwrite data and storage media.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.
